title: German Grilled Bratwurst Penne
description: A hearty German-inspired pasta dish with grilled bratwurst and penne pasta, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: Grill bratwurst sausages for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Cook penne pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add chopped onion, bell pepper, and tomato to the skillet.
Cook until vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add cherry tomatoes to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Slice grilled bratwurst sausages and add to the skillet.
Stir in grill seasoning and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Combine cooked penne pasta with the skillet mixture and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
